chunks: Or are the people of the towns secure that Our retribution should come to them in the forenoon while they are playing?

key_terms.أَهْلُ الْقُرَىٰ: The people of the towns (specifically referring to the Quraysh in Mecca)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'Ba'suna' coming in the forenoon while people are playing?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the suddenness of divine retribution against those who treat God's warnings as trivial, emphasizing that 'morning' (duhā) symbolizes a time of clarity when the unaware are caught off guard. It serves as a cautionary reminder that worldly leisure (la'ab) often masks spiritual negligence, a theme frequently cited by Imams to illustrate the unpredictability of death and the Day of Judgment.
